newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings light.
